title: 第11章 宴上赐婚第12章 记得把帽戴正
slug: 什么梦中的娘子都是真的
content_zh:
叶羽微微挑眉。
也有些不明所以。
皇帝日理万机，好端端的，怎么会突然想到他呢？
梦境之中。
这两年他可是一次都没回过京师。
一直都在外面的宗门晃荡。
这个时候点名要找。
估摸着不是什么好事啊。
【不仅是你感到好奇。
【就连叶良言也感到无比的忐忑。
【认为肯定是某位大臣或是王爷，在皇帝面前参了你一本。
【所以想要趁这个机会，敲打你一番。
【在抵达公主府时，叶良言再三叮嘱你。
【今日无论发生什么事情，一定要谨言慎微，虚心听教，切莫不可意气用事。
【皇帝的身体越来越不好，性格也变得很是暴虐。
【在这个时期，千万不要做出任何逾越之举。
【你若有所思的点了点头。
【这也是第一次感受到，伴君如伴虎的感觉。
【要知道，叶良言可是有着从龙之功，且一直龙恩浩荡。
【大乾王朝人尽皆知，叶良言就是皇帝心腹中的心腹。

【即便如此，还要如此小心。
【那其他人又该如何？】
【随后，你与叶良言走下马车。
【进入公主府后。
content_en:
Ye Yu raised his eyebrows slightly.
There is also some confusion.
The emperor was busy with everything, so why did he suddenly think of him?
In a dream.
In the past two years, he has not returned to the capital once.
He has been hanging out in the sect outside.
At this time, you need to find someone by name.
I guess it's not a good thing.
[You are not the only one who is curious.
[Even Ye Liangyan felt extremely uneasy.
[I think it must be a certain minister or prince who read your copy in front of the emperor.
[So I want to take this opportunity to beat you up.
[When arriving at the princess residence, Ye Liangyan warned you again and again.
[No matter what happens today, you must be careful with your words, listen to the teachings with an open mind, and never act out of anger.
[The emperor's health is getting worse and worse, and his personality has become very violent.
[During this period, please do not make any oversteps.
[You nodded thoughtfully.
[This is also the first time I feel that being with you is like being with a tiger.
[You must know that Ye Liangyan has the ability to follow the dragon, and he has always been graceful.
[Everyone in the Daqian Dynasty knew that Ye Liangyan was the emperor’s confidant.
[Even so, be so careful.
[What about other people? 】
[Then, you and Ye Liangyan stepped out of the carriage.
[After entering the princess mansion.
